input.quote: 5.2 The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership provision at all. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site (§1.1-1.3) and holds the Content, user information and order data (§2.1, §8.1), but nothing addresses ownership of the Site, its code, design and look and feel, or of the data the Site generates. Section 5.2 gives us only artistic and editorial control, §5.3 addresses title to physical Deerskin Products, and §6.1 is a trademark licence to HDI - none of these vests the developed Site or our data in us or gives us a licence back. Section 10.2's reference to "co-ownership" concerns the parties' relationship, not IP, so joint ownership of IP is also unaddressed. We therefore insert a single ownership clause at the preferred position covering our ownership and HDI's assignment of the work product, HDI's retention of its pre-existing IP with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence for embedded HDI IP, our retention of all rights in Content and site data, and no joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Insert an ownership clause vesting the Site and work product in the Company, with assignment, licence-back of embedded HDI IP, Company Data rights and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on who owns the Site, its code and look and feel, and the data it generates, so we add our preferred ownership position: we own and HDI assigns the work product created for us, HDI keeps its pre-existing IP subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence for anything embedded in the deliverables, we retain all rights in our Content and site data, and no intellectual property is jointly owned.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. The Company shall own all work product created for the Company under this Agreement, including the Site and its code, design and look and feel (the "Deliverables"), and HDI hereby assigns all right, title and interest in the Deliverables to the Company. HDI retains its pre-existing intellectual property and grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any HDI intellectual property embedded in the Deliverables. The Company retains all rights in the Content and in all user, customer and order data generated through the Site. The Parties shall not jointly own any intellectual property.
